problem: Given the Cartesian equation $7x+y-3=0$ of the plane $Π$, find an equation of $Π$ in the form $(r-p)\cdot n=0.$

activity_context.topic_title: The Cartesian Equation of a Plane

feedback.worked_solution:
First, from the equation of the plane we get that the normal vector of $Π$ is $n=⟨5,-7,4⟩.$

Now, we solve the Cartesian equation of $Π$ for $z$:

$$
\begin{aligned}5x-7y+4z+20 & =0 \\ z & =-\frac{5}{4}x+\frac{7}{4}y-5\end{aligned}
$$

If we put $x=0$ and $y=0$, we get $z=-5.$ Hence, the point $P(0,0,-5)$ lies on $Π.$ Note that the position vector of $P$ is $p=⟨0,0,-5⟩.$

Finally, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}(r-p)\cdot n & =0 \\ (r-⟨0,0,-5⟩)\cdot ⟨5,-7,4⟩ & =0.\end{aligned}
$$
